pattern: a send the user says to fork if a terminal holds the session
experience: The user wants a message to reach a Claude thread whose session a terminal may hold, and says to fork rather than wait; a send without forkIfHeld is refused and nothing is delivered.
rule: t3_thread_send has a forkIfHeld boolean; its name is all that describes it.

experience: Forking a session the user did not ask to fork splits its history; an ordinary send leaves forkIfHeld out.
rule: t3_thread_send has a forkIfHeld boolean; its name is all that describes it.
